extracted.summary: The SOF Girl Child Scholarship Scheme provides INR 5,000 annually to 300 female students in classes 1 to 10 across India.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks or equivalent in the previous academic year.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have a monthly family income of less than INR 25,000.
extracted.genders_quote: Applicants must be a female currently studying in classes 1 to 10 in a recognised school or institution.
